corruptSays.line: 📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 2). You can function through terror. Your hands shake but they work. This is a trained skill.
The stash count is off. 2 sticks missing. Nobody saw anything. Everybody suspects something.
Word reaches you, days late: Elias stands accused over what happened to Sofia. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
Benoit looks at the pantry, then at the Codex, then at you. "We’re going to make it." Haven will survive — because someone learned the land, and wrote it down. One less thing to fear.

Quinn leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Hushpuppy. Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📓 Codex: Counter: Wound the lead — Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free.
Word reaches you, days late: Sofia stands accused over what happened to Elias. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
Sofia has been talking at the fires. Enough voices — tonight they call a moot. Elias answers for what happened to Sofia.
Sofia calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.
Elias has been talking at the fires. Enough voices — tonight they call a moot. Sofia answers for what happened to Elias.
Elias calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.

◈ FLASHBACK — Lucky Coin
Worn smooth. James flipped it before every hard thing and said: heads or tails, it always lands on keep going. You have stopped checking which side lands.

◈ FLASHBACK — Field suture kit
You practiced on an orange. 'People are just oranges that bleed,' your instructor said, and then taught you how to not flinch. You haven't flinched since.

◈ FLASHBACK — Dispatcher's headset
You learned the voice — low, steady, unhurried. 'Panic is just information arriving too fast.' You hear it in your own voice now when it counts.

◈ FLASHBACK — Dog Tags
Not yours. Rafael's. You carry them so someone is remembered — the promise you made in the dust. Rafael would laugh at you carrying them into the apocalypse.
The moot doesn't wait forever. Two days of silence from the fire's edge — the count is taken without you.

(The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
You notice the village gives you room on the path now. Not fear, exactly. Room.
💔 A faction of Ashford has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Peter.
They're named, every one: Priya Frost, Alba Frost. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
📓 Codex: 2 petitioners from Ashford (cannibal): Priya Frost, Alba Frost.
They waited three days at the edge of your fire. Nobody called the moot. Priya nods — not angry, just done — and they walk.
